title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This strap-like muscle is the longest in your body.
Watch the long band crossing the front of the thigh.
Which muscle is glowing?
The rectus femoris is thicker and runs straight down the thigh.
This one slants from the front of the hip to the inner knee.
It's C. The sartorius.
Why it matters: its name comes from the Latin word for tailor.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle is glowing?
lines: This is the biggest muscle in the human body. Name it.
We're looking from behind at the hip.
Which muscle is glowing?
The gluteus medius lies partly beneath it, higher on the hip.
This one forms the bulk of your buttock and extends the hip.
It's B. The gluteus maximus.
Why it matters: it powers climbing stairs and standing up.

title: Leg Muscles
question: Which muscle group is it?
lines: The front of your thigh has a big muscle group.
Watch the glowing muscles on the front of the thigh.
Which muscle group is it?
The hamstrings are on the back of the thigh.
These muscles run down the front and join at the kneecap.
It's D. The quadriceps.
Why it matters: they straighten the knee when you stand up or kick.

title: Leg Muscles
question: What does the glowing muscle do?
lines: A long muscle along the front of your shin moves your foot.
Watch the glowing muscle beside the shinbone.
What does the glowing muscle do?
Pointing the toes down is the job of the calf muscles.
This one pulls the top of the foot toward the shin.
It's B. It lifts the foot up.
Why it matters: it helps your toes clear the ground with every step.
